metadata.description: Repo-agnostic feature and bug-fix pipelines for omp, driven by a per-repo .omp/relay.md profile

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: /relay-feature and /relay-bug lifecycle orchestrators (investigate, implement, complexity check, test, browser verify, docs-sync, base sync, two-lens review with re-review of rework, PR/MR) with specialist subagents, plus /relay-verify, /relay-commit, /relay-implement, /relay-review, /relay-grug and /relay-init
